newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Tuesday but buying interest was limited, traders said.
They said olein was generally quoted at 1,440 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers also heard at 1,445 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,222 rupiah/kg in Medan on Monday.
"The market was rather quiet as players waited for fresh leads," one trader said. "I don't think prices can move up much higher and they should begin to consolidate soon."
Traders said the Trading Corporation of Pakistan's tender for 2,000 to 4,000 tonnes of olein had little impact.
The MT Cakra l will leave on Thursday for Tanjung Priok with 2,000 tonnes olein, while the MT Istana l will leave for Cirebon today with 1,700 tonnes of olein.
The MT Prabu left Belawan on Monday for Tanjung Priok port in Jakarta with 1,800 tonnes of olein.
The traders said olein prices had increased sharply from last week on adjustment to high crude palm oil values.
Data from Tanjung Priok port showed that two shipments of 5,000 tonnes of palm oil from Malaysia had arrived at the port in Jakarta, believed to have been imported by a private firm.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Aziha will leave the North Sumatran port on Wednesday for Pasir Gudang, Malaysia with 27,540 tonnes of crude palm oil.
The MT Acada Dolphin will leave Belawan tomorrow for China with 2,000 tonnes of stearin, while the KM Matahari 19 will leave for Tanjung Priok on Wednesday with 1,000 tonnes of olein.
